functions.name: Invoke-GameServerRCON
functions.description: Envoie une commande à un serveur de jeu (Minecraft, Source Engine) via le protocole RCON et retourne la réponse.
functions.source:
function Invoke-GameServerRCON {
    param([string]$ServerIP, [int]$Port = 25575, [string]$Password, [string]$Command)
    # Utilisation d'un module RCON tiers ou implémentation TCP brute
    $tcp = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient($ServerIP, $Port)
    $stream = $tcp.GetStream()
    # Payload RCON simplifié (Type 3 = Auth, Type 2 = Exec)
    $authPayload = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes("$([char]0x00)$([char]0x00)$([char]0x00)$([char]0x00)$([char]0x03)$([char]0x00)$([char]0x00)$([char]0x00" + $Password + "$([char]0x00)$([char]0x00)")
    $stream.Write($authPayload, 0, $authPayload.Length)
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    $cmdPayload = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes("$([char]0x00)$([char]0x00)$([char]0x00)$([char]0x00)$([char]0x02)$([char]0x00)$([char]0x00)$([char]0x00" + $Command + "$([char]0x00)$([char]0x00)")
    $stream.Write($cmdPayload, 0, $cmdPayload.Length)
    $buffer = New-Object byte[] 1024
    $bytesRead = $stream.Read($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)
    $tcp.Close()
    return [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($buffer, 0, $bytesRead).Trim([char]0x00)
}
